channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: 70% of Assam’s flood-prone areas under control, says Water Resources Minister
item.description: Hazarika says Barak Valley occupy a “place of high priority” in the Assam government’s development agenda

item.title: Internet suspended in West Karbi Anglong; CM Sarma calls situation critical
item.description: Opposition has targeted the govt, accusing it of failing to bring the situation in the district under control

item.title: Karbi Anglong unrest: Two killed, over 45 injured amid eviction protests
item.description: The body of specially abled youth Suresh Dey was recovered from a burned building, while Athik Timung died during clashes in Karbi Anglong unrest.

item.title: Subansiri Lower unit 2 operational, NHPC targets timely commissioning of next units
item.description: With Unit 2 commissioned, the Subansiri Lower project moves toward launching three 250 MW units soon, followed by phased commissioning of remaining units in 2026–27.

item.title: Skipping meals, tobacco use triple throat cancer risk: BBCI–IASST study
item.description: The study is conducted by the city-based Dr B Borooah Cancer Institute (BBCI) and the Institute of Advanced Study in Science and Technology (IASST)

item.title: Karbi bodies condemn violence in West Karbi Anglong, call for peace & dialogue
item.description: They also stressed that all issues, including land-related disputes, can and must be resolved through dialogue, democratic processes, and constitutional and legal means.

item.title: Mission Chariali Flyover delay hits Tezpur traffic, Commuters demand repairs
item.description: Construction of the 3.2-km Mission Chariali flyover in Tezpur began in 2020 at Rs 275.9 crore, with completion targeted for 2026.

item.title: Unchecked deforestation triggers human-elephant conflict in Rani
item.description: The people have urged upon the authorities to take urgent and effective steps to curb forest destruction, strengthen forest protection measures.

item.title: Yuletide spirit fills Mizoram as state prepares for 155th Christmas celebrations
item.description: Three-day Christmas celebration starts from the evening of December 24, with 'urlawk zan' or pre-night celebration, and ends on December 26.
